changelog:
• Single Source of Truth Dynamic Versioning: Centralized versioning architecture with zero hardcoding across application, window titles, dialogs, and build pipelines
• Dynamic Candle-Click Snapping: 1-click snapping to candle High/Low for Entry/SL with default 1:2 R:R Take Profit, fully customizable by trader
• Master Class Edition Cockpit: Futuristic glassmorphic HUD styling with glowing Master Class badge, active coin pill illumination, and real-time balance tooltips
• Labels > Countdown to Bar Close Enabled by Default: Price scale countdown timer stays active out-of-the-box across timeframe switches and chart reloads
• Automatic Account Balance Refresh: Live and demo free margin automatically synchronizes across order placement, position market close, order cancellation, and WebSocket fills
• Clean Price Scale & On-Pill Price Badges: Entry, Take Profit, and Stop Loss exact prices render directly inside draggable pills instead of covering the right price bar, keeping live market price and bar countdown 100% visible
• DELTAIN Native Perpetual Feed Priority: Charts prioritize DELTAIN:{symbol}.P directly matching Delta Exchange India perpetual orderbook with Binance fallback only if unavailable
• Non-Destructive In-Place Timeframe Switching: Timeframe switches execute via chart JavaScript without browser page reloads
